source.quote: We expect to generate normalized FFO per share of $2.78 to $2.85 up from $2.68 to $2.77 We expect adjusted EBITDA of $442.5 million to $445.5 million compared with $434.5 million to $439.5 million Our updated guidance reflects stable residential populations for the rest of the year, except the facilities we are activating where we expect populations to continue to increase.

We expect to generate normalized FFO per share of $2.78 to $2.85 up from $2.68 to $2.77 We expect adjusted EBITDA of $442.5 million to $445.5 million compared with $434.5 million to $439.5 million Our updated guidance reflects stable residential populations for the rest of the year, except the facilities we are activating where we expect populations to continue to increase.
Finally, we expect our annual effective tax rate to be 27% to 28%, slightly higher related to the asset sales during the third quarter as well as higher nondeductible expenses.
